title: MARUGOTO A1 — 毎日の生活 (Daily Life in Japan)
description: From the Japan Foundation's MARUGOTO Japanese Online Course (まるごと) — a free, curriculum-based resource aligned with the JF Standard and CEFR A1 level (equivalent to JLPT N5). This lesson introduces daily life routines: waking up, commuting, eating, and evening activities, using authentic video dialogue from a family in Japan.
